    machine_factor = (1.0 + average) / (1.0 + average + p)
    time_factor = (1.0 + work) / (1.0 + work + finish)
    wait = max(0.0, start - job_ready)
    wait_factor = (1.0 + work) / (1.0 + work + wait)
    score = work * machine_factor * machine_factor * time_factor * wait_factor
    return score
```

review.description: 输入非负截断到1e9，工序数至少为1。average=work/operations，wait=max(0,start-job_ready)，返回work*((1+average)/(1+average+p))^2*(1+work)/(1+work+finish)*(1+work)/(1+work+wait)。综合剩余工作量、平方机器效率因子、完成时间因子与等待因子。其他项固定时，较短加工、较早完成和较少等待不会降低分数。
